def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    n=len(grid); m=len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x!=0)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    special=[x for x in counts if x!=bg]
    border=max(special,key=lambda x:counts[x])
    inner=next((x for x in special if x!=border),0)
    coords=[(r,c) for r in range(n) for c in range(m) if grid[r][c] in special]
    r0=min(r for r,c in coords); r1=max(r for r,c in coords)+1
    c0=min(c for r,c in coords); c1=max(c for r,c in coords)+1
    # Any main-colored cells well inside the rectangle indicate a solid block.
    solid=any(grid[r][c]==border for r in range(r0+1,r1-1) for c in range(c0+1,c1-1))
    out=[[bg]*m for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(r0,r1):
        for c in range(c0,c1):
            edge=r in (r0,r1-1) or c in (c0,c1-1)
            out[r][c]=border if edge or solid else inner
    if solid:
        for r in range(n//2-1,n//2+1):
            for c in range(m//2-1,m//2+1): out[r][c]=inner
    return out

        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)

    inner=next((x for x in others if any(grid[r][c]==x for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1))),0)
    bg=next((x for x in others if x!=inner),0)
    solid=any(grid[r][c]==border for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1))
    out=[[bg]*m for _ in range(n)]

            hole=inner if inner else 0
